mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 67 degree temperatures near the Military Ridge State Trail. We also have a full moon tonight. The International Space Station will pass overhead, but please be aware that we will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has announced that a segment of Highway M will be closed to traffic from October 5 through October 7 to allow crews to complete final road work. Additionally, please be cautious of email scams impersonating city staff; remember that official payments for planning applications must be made via check at the administration building.

There is a lot happening this weekend! Today, the Dane County Farmers Market is open, and we have live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for Yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28 and trivia nights starting on September 29.
In our weekly police report, officers noted an incident on September 5 where they discovered vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields, confirming it was part of a viral social media prank.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
